Container.Name: bragi
Container.Overview: Bragi is one app for your media collection: request a show, and Bragi finds it through Prowlarr or Jackett, sends it to NZBGet, SABnzbd, qBittorrent or Soulseek (slskd), and files it into your library. TV, movies, ebooks and audiobooks; music to follow.[br][br]Map your downloads and media under one /data share so Bragi can hardlink instead of copying.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: One share holding both downloads and media (e.g. /data/torrents, /data/usenet, /data/media/tv), so imports are instant hardlinks.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for new files.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error. Use debug when reporting a problem; logs show under the container's Logs icon.
